title: GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price
summary: OpenAI announces GPT 6.1 Sol, a new large language model that delivers near-top-tier intelligence (comparable to Astra-class models) at approximately 20% of the cost, making advanced AI capabilities significantly more accessible to developers and enterprises.
problem_solved: Reduces the cost barrier for accessing high-quality AI intelligence, making advanced LLM capabilities affordable for a broader range of applications and users.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to near-state-of-the-art AI by offering comparable intelligence at a fraction of the price, enabling more cost-effective AI-powered applications and services.
